whatIs: One Page Love is a gallery of single-page sites, curated since 2008. Besides the sites, which are tagged by genre (portfolio, landing page, SaaS, e-commerce, restaurant, experimental), it organizes examples by section type (testimonials, FAQ, pricing, lead capture) and by typeface, and includes templates and articles.
It's a good fit when you're about to build a landing page or a portfolio and want to see how others solved a specific section or a similar genre.
uses: Looking at pricing or FAQ section examples before designing yours.
Searching for sites that use a typeface like Inter or Montserrat to see how it's applied.
Starting from a free or paid template for a landing page in Next.js with Tailwind or in Framer.
caveats: It only collects single-page sites, so it's no use for seeing app flows.
Part of the template catalog is paid, with individual prices of around $39 to $47.
The templates use different technologies (Next.js, Framer); check which one each uses before choosing it.
pricingNote: The gallery is free; some templates are sold separately starting at about $39.
idealFor: Anyone building a landing page or a portfolio who wants references by section or genre.
